incidents-bot: Pager: org=tidebreaker (tb-842) experiencing sustained 429s on /v1/generate. 5m error rate > 18%. Auto-mitigation did not trigger.

ashley_oncall: I'm on it, picking up pager. what's the current qps and quota?

mike_sre: dashboard -> https://metrics.redwood.ai/d/tidebreaker?panel=rl 
traffic showing burst to ~220 qps, org reserved 50 qps, RL dropping to 429. No increased 5xx.

ashley_oncall: clear customer impact: multiple customer sessions reporting failures; CS pinged. Assigning mitigation plan: 1) temporary org-level rate bump 2) enable canary fallback to smaller model 3) if needed disable heavy feature flag (embed-prewarm).

jen_product: Sarah (CS) already on call with Tidebreaker. They confirm at least 30% user requests failing in their webapp. They're asking for immediate relief.

sarah_csm: on the call: customer can tolerate brief degraded quality but not extended downtime. They asked for fastest fix even if cost increases.

kevin_platform: I can apply an emergency RL override. Proposed override: set org qps=120 for 30m, with automatic rollback if error rate >5% or latency >800ms. OK?

ashley_oncall: ok run it, but do a staged canary: 20% of their traffic first. We'll observe for 2 min then ramp.

mike_sre: Command I'm going to run from control node:
```bash
rdwctl rl override --org tb-842 --qps 120 --scope staged --stages 20,50,100 --step-interval 120s --ttl 1800
```

deploy-bot: rollout started: rl-override/tb-842/staged v1 -> stage=20% at 1748801184

ashley_oncall: monitor logs for error trend and tail requests. If 5xx pops up, rollback immediately.

mike_sre: stage 20% looks good: 429s dropped by 65% for sampled sessions. latency +30ms. Ramping to 50% now.

deploy-bot: stage=50% applied at 1748801227

jen_product: I've flipped the embed-prewarm feature flag to false for tb-842 in case heavy embed calls are the culprit (ff: tb_embed_prewarm=false). Noting in thread for postmortem.

mike_sre: ramp to 100% complete at 1748801250. Overall customer 429s down to baseline. No rise in 500s.

ashley_oncall: leaving the override in place but reducing to monitored mode: setting alert to notify if error_rate > 3% for 2 mins. Also creating ticket to evaluate quota increases + workload shaping for this customer.

sarah_csm: customer confirmed reduced failures, they say site recovered. They want a follow-up tomorrow on permanent capacity.

kevin_platform: capture: applied emergency staged override (qps 120 ttl 30m), disabled embed-prewarm for org, canary fallback to smaller model enabled for long requests. Will record exact commands in the incident ticket.

ashley_oncall: I'll hand off to next oncall in 30m and create an incident record. Action items:
- ops: run post-incident qps analysis and suggest permanent quota change (mike_sre)
- platform: add safer auto-mitigation threshold (kevin_platform)
- product/CS: coordinate with Tidebreaker on expected traffic pattern and pricing impact (jen_product, sarah_csm)

mike_sre: noted. I'll attach logs and request traces to the ticket.

ashley_oncall: handing off to mike_sre for monitoring and follow-ups. I'm unpinging. :wave:

mike_sre: taking over monitoring. leaving override until ttl expires at 1748801922 unless we extend.
